title: Arabic Handwritten Text Line Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a new dataset for handwritten Arabic word recognition. While the source documents for the dataset are historical Arabic manuscripts, some of which are described as containing content related to 'prophets' or 'musical modes', the paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. These descriptions merely identify the nature of the historical texts used as data sources, not the subject of the paper's analysis or ethical considerations.
